method: Bytes of each staged installer (stage-release-assets.sh output), checked by scripts/check-artifact-size.mjs in the desktop artifact smoke for the nightly and the release build.
ratchet: Baseline: the v2.5.0 release assets (2026-10-29), except the AppImages, which come from the dev build of 2026-10-30 (#2914 added the GStreamer video plugins after v2.5.0: x64 158.2 MB, arm64 151.8 MB). Budget = baseline + 3 %, rounded up to the next 100 KB. A raise goes up by at most 3 % and says why in its PR; a PR that shrinks an installer lowers its budget. Phase Q4 goal: 20 % below the v2.5.0 size.
